meta.descripcion: Three mountains, one village and a 2,263-metre descent. A fictional ski resort, built as a portfolio project.

hero.texto: First light paints the peaks red long before it reaches the valley. Start at the top, 3,883 metres up, and ski down with us to the village.

hoyNoche.texto: The village lights are still on and the first lifts open at 8:30. Tomorrow you ski on freshly groomed snow.

nubes.texto: At 3,412 metres the valley vanishes under a white sea. Keep going down: on the other side the day has begun.

vistazo.texto: Three sectors linked by lifts, from the village at 1,620 metres to the glacier at 3,883.

forfaits.texto: Unlimited access to every lift in all three sectors, including the Sunnegga funicular and the Gornergrat railway.

confirmacion.texto: At a real resort, your passes would arrive on your phone here, and you could collect them at any ticket office with this order number.

faq.pregunta: Can I use the pass in all three sectors?
faq.respuesta: Yes. The full pass opens every lift in Sunnegga, Gornergrat and Glacier Paradise, plus the cog railway between them.

faq.pregunta: What if the lifts close because of wind?
faq.respuesta: If more than half the lifts are closed for a whole day, that day is refunded as credit for a pass in the same season.
Yes: with at least one adult and two children in the same purchase, the total drops by 10%. Children under 6 ride free.

faq.pregunta: Do I need a printed pass?
faq.respuesta: No. Each pass has a number the gates read from your phone, and you can also collect it as a card at any ticket office.
